jobs.description:
Join our team Revenue Operations as a Manager of Commercial Master Data (x|f|m) and manage master data quality and lifecycle across systems by executing data maintenance, monitoring quality, and clarifying data usage to support reliable commercial execution and enable consistent downstream activities. This is how you contribute to what matters most: better health for more people.

Based in Goettingen with the possibility to work some days in a week remotely, you will lead a global team who look forward to shaping the future together with you.

Please submit your application in English only. Thank you!

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

- Execute customer, contact and pricing master data creation, updates, and corrections by applying defined request workflows, validation checks, and approval rules based on agreed data standards to support reliable performance of daily commercial activities
- Monitor data quality by running regular checks on critical fields, analyzing error patterns, tracking recurring inconsistencies and consolidating findings into visible data quality insights to maintain stable, usable master data for consistent operational use
- Clarify correct usage of master data fields by translating agreed definitions into practical guidance and validation rules to ensure consistent data handling across commercial operations
- Assess the impact of master data changes by reviewing affected downstream activities and identifying potential execution risks to prevent disruptions to commercial processes and workflows
- Document and escalate cross-system data inconsistencies by structuring issue descriptions, root causes, and business impact for IT resolution and tracking resolution progress to ensure aligned data usage across systems
- Provide guidance to commercial users on correct data handling by sharing clear instructions and highlighting common error patterns to improve data quality and reduce recurring operational errors

What Will Convince Us

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Life Science, Data Management or related field
- Several years of experience in master data management, commercial operations, or data quality roles
- Demonstrated leadership experience in a comparable role
- Deep understanding of customer, contact and pricing data structures and associated system landscapes
- SAP (S/4HANA) expertise required, experience with Salesforce (SFDC) is beneficial
- Strong experience in data maintenance, cleansing, and quality monitoring
- Experience managing high-volume operational data processes with defined SLAs
- Clear understanding of how master data supports commercial execution and reporting
- Ability to communicate and coordinate data-related topics across commercial teams and IT using structured issue definition and escalation
- Solid capability to analyze data issues and translate them into actionable correction measures
- Fluent in English, German and/or Spanish language skills would be beneficial

jobs.occupation: ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d) (ERP-Berater/in - ERP-Consultant)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our Digital Transformation team, Airbus is looking for a

ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d)

The Mission & Scope

Airbus Aerostructures is pioneering its digital transformation, and we are seeking a proactive SAP Technical Expert with a strong leadership mindset. You will bridge architectural vision and hands-on execution, ensuring seamless business continuity across our legacy systems while steering operational readiness for our S/4HANA Cloud transition.

Scope: Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technical Solutions, S/4HANA Cloud, and SAP BTP.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Operations (On-Premise & Cloud): Act as the primary technical SME and lead deep-level administration, HANA DB optimization, trace analysis, and central infrastructure orchestration (Cloud Connectors, Web Dispatchers, STMS/ChaRM, SSO) across hybrid environments.
- Advanced S/4HANA Operations & Migrations: Lead S/4HANA conversion activities—including advanced SUM/DMO transitions—and manage S/4HANA Cloud testing landscapes, system refreshes, and target provisioning.
- Lifecycle Management, Monitoring & Automation: Drive system enhancements and release cycles, manage high-availability/disaster recovery setups, implement observability frameworks (SAP Cloud ALM / BTP), and design Infrastructure-as-Code workflows to automate standard BASIS routines.
- Security, Compliance & Audit Readiness: Enforce system hardening, patch orchestration, and SSL/TLS certificate management. Monitor security/gateway logs, remediate vulnerabilities, and lead technical preparations for internal and external SAP audits in alignment with cybersecurity standards.
- Project Management & Service Leadership: Ideate, steer, and deliver complex technical projects to optimize ERP performance and transformations. Drive continuous improvement in partner service delivery and manage connectivity pipelines (REST/SOAP/RFC APIs, SAP Event Mesh) across cross-functional teams.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Degree in Computer Science / Business Informatics OR a vocational degree as an IT Specialist with proven advanced training.
- Experience & Mindset: Multi-year track record in SAP BASIS and platform infrastructure administration for complex hybrid landscapes, paired with a project-leading mindset.
- Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP HANA DB (Linux/Windows), SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, and SAP Cloud ALM.
- Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills in complex, matrixed organizations.
- Languages: Proficient in English; German language skills are a strong advantage

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Your Role

As a Principal Scientist in the Structural Biology and Biophysics team, R&D Discovery, you will provide scientific leadership in interdisciplinary projects to elucidate structural mode of action and enable structure-based design with a focus on macromolecular complexes of antibodies, multispecifics and molecular degraders. You will strengthen our X-ray crystallography capabilities and, where possible complement our cryo-EM workflows to establish integrated, end-to-end experimental strategies for structural enablement — spanning protein and sample generation, data acquisition, and structural model building. You coordinate CRO/collaboration partner activities for reagents and data generation and drive innovations in structural biology. You clearly explain and communicate scientific findings and proposals to cross-functional teams and stakeholders to support informed and fast decision-making. You will mentor and develop junior scientists in structure biology and drug discovery contributing to a high-performing, collaborative culture.

Who You Are

- PhD in Structural Biology or a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience (including biopharma, biotech) and strong track record to design, execute and drive complex structural biology projects.
- Deep expertise in high-resolution structure determination of proteins and protein complexes by Xray crystallography (sample generation, data collection & processing, structure refinement with industry-standard software).
- Experience working with antigen–antibody and protein degrader complexes, with a deep understanding of structure–function relationships.
- Ideally hands-on with single-particle cryo-EM and biophysical (e.g. HDX-MS, SAXS; Refeyn, FIDA, DSF)
- Experience with cloud-based/HPC data management and processing; LINUX scripting; AI/ML-based prediction of biomolecular structures.
- Effective collaborator and leader in multidisciplinary settings with excellent English communication; skilled in guiding/mentoring scientists, coordinating multi-site work, and managing CROs to balance project demands.
- Proven ability to convey complex data clearly to drive decisions; strong publication history or impactful drug discovery contributions (oncology/immunology/neuroscience favored); excellent problem-solving abilities and experience introducing relevant new technologies.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The Opportunity

Worldline is an international company with branches and subsidiaries in several countries within the European Union. As a regulated Payment Institution it is important to have good oversight over the activities in the whole group. We are looking for a Financial Crime Compliance Specialist with experience in an international context to organize and improve this oversight.
This specialist must have profound knowledge of the European and German legislation. Knowledge of other European legislation (Luxembourg, Netherlands, UK, Nordics, Czech,…) is a plus.
We are looking for a professional with profound Financial Crime Compliance knowledge and experience, preferably within the Payments Industry. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

- You organize international oversight within the Worldline NV/SA Group for Financial Crime Compliance
- You keep track of regulatory and industry Financial Crime standards and requirements in an international context.
- You prepare reporting to Management and to the authorities
- You perform compliance risk assessments.
- You advise Management and stakeholders on KYC, AML/CFT and Sanctions and regulatory related risks and requirements.
- You prepare training on FCC topics
- You keep relevant KYC, AML/CFT and Sanctions policies, guidelines, procedures and work instructions up to date in alignment with regulations and group policies.
- You conduct and support the performance of 2nd line controls and assessments. You assess the controls executed by 1st line
- You analyze transaction monitoring alerts reported by 1st line and report irregularities indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing to the authorities.
- You are a pro-active team player who can work independently and is focused on delivery and quality.
- You ensure compliance with international law and regulations (AML/CFT, Sanctions) and protect the company from being used for these activities.
- You actively participate in challenging Compliance projects.
- You prove integrity and professional ethics.
- You have a strong compliance focus, while looking for improved efficiency 

Who Are We Looking For

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

-   You have a university degree in either law, finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent through experience
- Preferably a completed certification course on one the themes from a renowned international organisation such as ACAMS, IIA.
- You have experience in an AML/CFT compliance role.
- You have strong attention to detail in order to identify and correct risky practices.
- You possess excellent analytical skills and the ability to accurately interpret complex legislation, documents and policies.
- You have strong presentation and problem-solving skills.
- You have a strong knowledge of relevant supervision laws i.e. PSD2, EU AML legislative framework, local (at least German) Anti-Money Laundering Act and Sanctions laws.
- You are proficient in the use of Microsoft-Office Products.
- You master statistical analysis and research.
- You have a solid understanding of business processes in the payment and e-transaction field.
- You have experience with good practices for information sharing (e.g. in SharePoint, Teams, OneNote, JIRA,…)
- You have excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
- You have good communication skills in German
- You have a Multicultural mindset and flexibility, able to work in an international and constantly evolving environment

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. This is one of the most strategically significant roles in the new CREM structure — and in many respects the strategic right hand of the Head of CREM. As Head of Strategy & Real Estate, you will build and lead the capability that connects Merck's business direction to its global real estate portfolio: translating corporate strategy into actionable portfolio plans, owning the business partnering relationships with sector leadership, and overseeing the execution of transactions across EMEA, AMER and APAC.
This is a newly created function. Portfolio strategy, proactive planning and workplace strategy do not currently exist in a mature form within Merck's real estate organisation — you will establish them. Transactions capability exists and is largely retained; your mandate is to elevate it from reactive execution to strategically-led delivery.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Portfolio Strategy: Lead the development and annual refresh of CREM's Real Estate Plan of Record — translating business growth, consolidation and transformation requirements into a multi-year portfolio strategy with clear priorities, scenarios and business cases. Own portfolio optimisation as the function's primary strategic output.
- Business Partnering: Serve as a senior strategic partner to business sector leads across Healthcare, Life Science and Electronics — embedding CRE into business planning cycles before decisions are made, not after. Build trusted relationships that position CREM as a value-creating partner.
- M&A Support – Lead on all aspects of Real Estate and FM due diligence to support Merck M&A activity, managing cross-border due diligence and master planning to capture portfolio synergies, mitigate risk, and prepare portfolio integration plan. Once M&A transaction is signed then lead the implementation of all portfolio and service delivery integration activities.
- Workplace & Occupancy Strategy: Own workplace and occupancy planning strategy at a global level — setting standards, guiding space utilisation principles and ensuring portfolio decisions reflect both business needs and efficiency targets.
- Market Intelligence: Oversee the function's market intelligence capability — leveraging external partners and broker relationships to ensure portfolio decisions are backed by real market insight, proactive lease expiry management and benchmarked market data.
- Transaction Oversight: Provide strategic direction and oversight to the regional Transaction Managers across EMEA, AMER and APAC — ensuring all transactions are strategy-led, governed consistently and executed to a high standard. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher positions - Statistical Physics and Active Matter - (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
In the Department of Living Matter Physics (LMP) we seek to fill a number of

Postdoctoral Researcher positions.

- Statistical Physics and Active Matter -

The Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization (MPI-DS) at Göttingen, Germany, is an international, interdisciplinary and collaborative environment offering an exceptional research setting. It hosts a range of theoretical and experimental fundamental scientific research and a diverse group of researchers. Altogether, it employs about 300 people. 

The LMP department engages in a wide range of theoretical research aimed at understanding the dynamics of living systems from a physical perspective. The department currently hosts Ramin Golestanian (director), Philip Bittihn (group leader), Suropriya Saha (group leader), and a number of postdoctoral researchers, students, and visitors.

The research

The postdoctoral researchers will engage in theoretical and computational research in Nonequilibrium Statistical Physics and Active Matter. For more information, visit our website (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp) ).

Your profile

We are looking for excellent, enthusiastic and self-motivated researchers with relevant background and good communication skills to join our research team. 

The ideal candidate should have:

- A PhD/DPhil degree (or comparable) with a background in theoretical physics, applied mathematics or related disciplines from a recognized university;
- Prior experience with nonequilibrium statistical physics and a strong interest in active matter physics;
- Ability and desire to work in an international team on inter-disciplinary research topics;
- Good command of English, which is the working language of the department. German is an asset but not required.

Our offer

We are offering excellent working conditions in a highly interdisciplinary and stimulating research environment. Salary is in accordance with the German state public service salary scale (E13 TVöD-Bund) and the corresponding social benefits. Working hours are full time. We offer opportunities regarding work life balance as well as health promotion services. The postdoctoral appointment is for two years. The starting date is flexible.

The Max-Planck Society is committed to achieving the highest level of excellence and diversity. We encourage applications from women, especially in areas where they are underrepresented, which includes theoretical physics. Moreover, we are committed to providing suitable working environment for everyone including individuals with disabilities.

Your application

To apply, please follow this link (https://s.b-ite.com/vd1cg)  and submit your CV, publication list, a statement of research interest, and contacts of two referees. In addition to the description of your proposed research, it should also briefly describe your past and current research interests and why you are interested in joining our department. Processing of applications will start after the deadline of 10th January 2027, and will stop when the positions are filled.

jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/w/d) (Open) (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging your expertise in implantation, epitaxy, glass-processing technologies, and furnace systems, you will play a key role in maintaining stable, quality-compliant, and cost-efficient manufacturing processes while meeting the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.

You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. Our working environment is built on openness, trust, and collaborative teamwork, providing an atmosphere where technical expertise is valued, innovation is encouraged, and both professional and personal development can thrive.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Ownership

- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass Processes, Implantation, and Furnaces).
- Ensure high equipment availability and process stability.
- Conduct fault analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance and repair activities.

Process and Quality Optimization

- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)
- Yield and Product Quality
- Perform statistical analyses and root-cause investigations.
- Support the qualification of new processes, products, and equipment upgrades.

Project Management

- Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.
- Plan and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.
- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.
- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.

Production Support

- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.
- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.

Other Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.
- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.
- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.
- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:

- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering
- Physics
- Materials Science
- Or a comparable technical field

Professional Experience

- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.
- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.

Technical Expertise

- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.
- Experience with MES and ERP systems.
- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
- High level of initiative and ownership.
- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
- Continuous Improvement mindset.

Language Skills

- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.
- Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers and development partners.
